Here are some well-known repositories you can try manually:

| **National Archives of Ireland (nationalarchives.ie)** | Census fragments (1821, 1831, 1841, 1851), Tithe Applotments, and estate records. |
| **Griffith's Valuation Online (askaboutireland.ie)** | Land survey 1847–1864; can confirm a Kelly family's location around the birth year. |

**Tip:** Since Bridget was born ~1845, her baptism would appear in a **Catholic parish register** (if her family was Catholic, which was common). IrishGenealogy.ie is your best free starting point. Search for the parish covering the townland or county where her family lived.
